# omniddi_ipam_subnet (Resource)

Manages a planning-only IPAM subnet. Writes are synchronous. DHCP service is enabled separately; this resource never sends a DHCP server group. The `id` equals the OmniDDI network id used by DHCP resources. This resource owns the `SUBNET` tags of the subnet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "omniddi_ipam_container" "datacenter" {
  cidr = "10.10.0.0/16"
}

resource "omniddi_ipam_subnet" "lab" {
  parent_id    = data.omniddi_ipam_container.datacenter.id
  network_addr = "10.10.1.0"
  prefix       = 24
  name         = "lab"
  description  = "Lab servers"
  owner        = "netops"
  vlan_id      = 110

  deletion_protection = true

  tags = {
    env = "prod"
  }
}

resource "omniddi_ipam_subnet" "documentation_v6" {
  network_addr = "2001:db8:1::"
  prefix       = 48
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_addr` (String) Network address of the subnet, for example `192.0.2.0` or `2001:db8:1::`. It must be the network address for `prefix`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `prefix` (Number) Prefix length of the subnet (0-32 for IPv4, 0-128 for IPv6). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `business_unit_id` (Number) Business unit of the subnet. Inherited from the parent when not set. Changing a configured value forces a new resource.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Refuse to delete the object while true. Set to false and apply before destroying. Defaults to `true`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Allow deleting a subnet that has DHCP service configured, which removes its DHCP configuration, reservations and leases together with the subnet. Defaults to `false`.
- `name` (String) Name of the subnet. Defaults to its CIDR.
- `owner` (String) Owner label.
- `parent_id` (Number) Id of the parent `FAMILY` or `CONTAINER` node. When omitted, the subnet is placed under the deepest container that holds its CIDR. OmniDDI always places a subnet under the deepest containing container, so set this to the immediate parent. Changing a configured value forces a new resource.
- `protocol` (String) `IPv4` or `IPv6`. Derived from `network_addr` when not set and must match it. Changing a configured value forces a new resource.
- `tags` (Map of String) Single-valued OmniDDI tags. Tag definitions must already exist. Merged with provider `default_tags`.
- `tags_list` (Map of List of String) Multi-valued (list) OmniDDI tags. Tag definitions must already exist.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `vlan` (String) VLAN label. Conflicts with `vlan_id`.
- `vlan_id` (Number) Numeric VLAN id, stored by OmniDDI as the VLAN label. Conflicts with `vlan`.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String) The subnet in CIDR notation.
- `created_on` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) The OmniDDI network id of the subnet (`networks.id`).
- `status` (String) `ACTIVE`, `INACTIVE` or `DEPRECATED`.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All single-valued tags on the object, including those inherited from provider `default_tags`.
- `updated_on` (String) Last update timestamp.

Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import omniddi_ipam_subnet.lab 57
terraform import omniddi_ipam_subnet.lab 10.10.1.0/24
```
